name: AHT25 temperature & humidity sensor
description: Aosong (ASAIR) digital temperature (-40 to 80 °C, ±0.3 °C typical) and relative humidity (0–100 %, ±2 % typical) sensor with an I2C interface and a CRC-checked 20-bit reading. Runs on 2.2–5.5 V; no pull-ups on the sensor. Sold as: ASAIR AHT25 temperature & humidity sensor (Aosong, 4-pin 2.54 mm plug-in: VDD, SDA, GND, SCL), fixed I2C address 0x38.
eli5: Tells your board how warm the air is and how damp it is.

pins.name: VDD
pins.description: Supply, 2.2–5.5 V; use the same voltage as your board's logic (3.3 V on ESP32/Pico)

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data; needs an external pull-up (e.g. 4.7 kΩ) to VDD

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock; needs an external pull-up (e.g. 4.7 kΩ) to VDD

supplierQuery: ASAIR AHT25 temperature humidity sensor I2C
buildNotes: Pin order is VDD, SDA, GND, SCL (datasheet Table 5, not the usual VCC, GND, SCL, SDA): check before wiring.
The sensor has no I2C pull-ups: fit 4.7 kΩ from SDA and SCL to VDD (the microcontroller's weak internal pull-ups are not enough).
Power VDD from the microcontroller's logic voltage (3.3 V on ESP32/Pico): the datasheet says MCU and sensor must share the supply voltage.
Put a 100 nF capacitor between VDD and GND close to the sensor.
Wait at least 100 ms after power-on, then read one status byte: (status & 0x18) must equal 0x18, otherwise run Aosong's 0x1B/0x1C/0x1E register initialisation.
Measure: send 0xAC 0x33 0x00, wait 80 ms, read until status bit 7 (busy) is clear, then read 7 bytes: status, 20-bit humidity, 20-bit temperature, CRC (poly 0x31, init 0xFF).
Measure no more often than every 2 s, or the sensor self-heats; keep it away from the regulator and the microcontroller.
The address is fixed at 0x38, so only one AHT25 per I2C bus. Do not reflow or wave-solder it; hand-solder under 5 s at up to 300 °C, or plug it into a 4-pin 2.54 mm socket.

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from aht25 import AHT25

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
sensor = AHT25(i2c)
while True:
    t, h = sensor.read()
    print('T=%.1fC H=%.0f%%' % (t, h))
    time.sleep(2)
